questions.question: Name South Africa's six neighbouring countries and give the direction of each from South Africa.
questions.expected_answer: Namibia is to the north-west, Botswana to the north, Zimbabwe to the north-east, Mozambique to the north-east and east, Eswatini to the east, and Lesotho is surrounded by South Africa.

questions.question: Match each neighbouring country with its capital city.
questions.expected_answer: Namibia: Windhoek. Botswana: Gaborone. Zimbabwe: Harare. Mozambique: Maputo. Eswatini: Mbabane, with Lobamba as the royal and parliamentary capital. Lesotho: Maseru.

questions.question: Give three ways in which South Africa and its neighbours are linked.
questions.expected_answer: They share languages, such as Setswana, Sesotho and siSwati; they trade goods across the borders; Lesotho sends water to Gauteng; the money of Namibia, Lesotho and Eswatini is linked to the rand; and they work together in SADC.
